records.note: Still vague against the full registry. 'More international discussion and collaboration' and 'comprehensive drug policy reform' name no body, no rule and no countable set. 'More' has no benchmark, so no registry event of the same asset and outcome type can be found.

'The biggest challenge is going to be the cost' is a comparative with no benchmark, no price and no payer. He does not say a payer refuses coverage, so it does not map to the coverage events (E-0116, E-0050). No checkable event.

'Enough openness' and 'figured out group therapy' have no criterion. 'Tens of thousands of therapists' is a therapist count; the registry holds a count of treatment centres (E-0087), a different asset and threshold, so a match would invent one. 'Multiple generations' is not in the anchor table.

FDA approval of MDMA-assisted therapy (E-0001) is the antecedent, not the claim; he does not assert it. The consequent, 'a new key to unlocking PTSD' and reduced trauma 'generation-over-generation', is a slogan with no observable criterion and no date.

'Tens of thousands of well-trained practitioners will be needed' states a requirement, not a count reached by a date. No practitioner series exists in the registry; E-0087 counts treatment centres, a different asset. No deadline words.

'Millions of people we hope to help' is a quantifier with no countable set. The registry holds a cumulative treated count with the threshold 1.4 million (E-0091); mapping 'millions' to it would invent the threshold. No date.

'Only the first of many psychedelic-assisted therapies' is a quantifier with no countable set and names no second compound. The registry class events are first approvals (E-0024, E-0066, E-0117); none is 'many follow'. No date.

records.note: Recovered: the registry now holds E-0091, the same asset (people treated with MDMA-assisted therapy) and outcome type (a count reaching a threshold). The number 1.4 million and the year 2032 are his own words, so nothing is invented. 'By 2032' gives 31 December 2032 (year rule, anchor). 'Will' is the strongest phrase, so bin A; 'hopefully' and 'some estimates' hedge the number, not the assertion. Affiliated: MAPS is named in the event and he leads it, but patients, clinics and payers decide the count.

'Net-zero trauma test country' has no criterion, and the registry holds no Iceland coverage or national-insurance event. '20, 30 years' is a range the anchor table does not resolve. No entity decides an observable outcome here.

records.note: Recovered: the registry now holds E-0099, and its readings treat 'if the FDA says, we want another phase three study' as the FALSE side of that event. He raises the new-Phase-3 requirement, so asserts is false and bin C from 'could'. The FDA decides, so this is not CONTROL; affiliated because he founded MAPS and the sponsor of the named NDA. The words 'another three and a half years or so' measure a delay of approval, not a date for the FDA's path decision, so the item is undated.
'This wave is unstoppable' and 'healing potentials in so many different ways' are slogans. No entity, event, threshold or date can be written, so no registry event fits.

Better code than VAGUE: the only assertion is 'MAPS will continue leading this integration', and MAPS is his own organization, so it decides the outcome. 'As psychedelics become more accessible' is presupposed, and 'more accessible' has no benchmark.

Better code than VAGUE: the listed actions (incubating research, training therapists, humanitarian projects, building infrastructure) are MAPS' own decisions, and Doblin leads MAPS. 'Lykos will continue negotiations with the FDA' is a private company step, not the FDA action of E-0122.

He names insurance coverage as the key factor and the big challenge; he does not say a payer covers a named treatment. Without a payer, a treatment and a policy, the coverage events (E-0116, E-0050, E-0064) cannot be matched. No date.

'Likely to be very helpful' has no observable criterion: no FDA guidance, SPA decision or rule is named as the result. The letter itself is already public on the statement date, so only the unmeasurable effect remains.

'A key challenge in 2022 will be the early negotiations with insurance companies' names a task, not an outcome. Private negotiations have no public resolution source, and no payer or policy is named, so the coverage events do not fit. The year 2022 has nothing to date.

'Many running out of money' is a quantifier with no countable set and no company named. E-0055 counts pandemic-era mental-health companies with a threshold of two; psychedelic company consolidation is a different set, and a threshold would have to be invented.
